sloka: इन्द्रियाणि इन्द्रिय अर्थैः तु पन्च पन्चभिर् उत्तमैः ।तर्पयाम् आस माता इव तदा रावण पालिता ॥५-९-३०॥
transliteration: indriyāṇi indriya arthaiḥ tu panca pancabhir uttamaiḥ ।tarpayām āsa mātā iva tadā rāvaṇa pālitā ॥5-9-30॥

translations.english: The chamber of Ravana, like a mother, gratified all the five senses of Hanuman with proper objects of the senses.
